exitCodeConventions.exit3: COULD-NOT-VERIFY (network or missing key/environment dependency; cards P1-2 and P1-4 must conform to this convention rather than reinventing error codes)

preamblePolicy.errTrap: echo ERROR: command failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND} >&2; exit 1

versionPolicy.rules: Non-empty, starts with alphanumeric [0-9A-Za-z], followed by alphanumeric, dot, underscore, or hyphen; no slashes, no leading dot; exits 1 on failure.

containerisedUtilities.digestPinObligation: SLSI-P1-2 is responsible for resolving, digest-pinning, and signing this image into bundle/images/ under Decision 9 and Decision 10.

openssl.resolution: Decision 10: Containerise openssl and envsubst, re-scope P1-1
openssl.wrapperBehavior: Invokes 'docker run --rm -i --network none -v ${PWD}:${PWD} -w ${PWD} ${SLSI_UTILITY_IMAGE} openssl "$@"'. Preflight checks docker and local image inspection; fails loudly with exit 1 naming host remedy 'apt-get install -y openssl' and appliance remedy 'docker load < bundle/images/slsi-util.tar'. Refuses silent fallback to unpinned host binary.
openssl.rationale: Upstream OpenSSL publishes source code only, zero precompiled Linux release binaries. Distro extraction creates glibc/musl dynamic linking dependencies; static compilation requires cross-compiler toolchains. Served via signed platform image in bundle/images/.

envsubst.resolution: Decision 10: Containerise openssl and envsubst, re-scope P1-1
envsubst.wrapperBehavior: Invokes 'docker run --rm -i --network none <exported_env_vars> -v ${PWD}:${PWD} -w ${PWD} ${SLSI_UTILITY_IMAGE} envsubst "$@"'. Injects exported caller variables (-e) while preserving GNU gettext restricted-variable allow-list syntax (e.g., envsubst '${VAR}'). Preflight checks docker and local image inspection; fails loudly with exit 1 naming host remedy 'apt-get install -y gettext-base' and appliance remedy 'docker load < bundle/images/slsi-util.tar'. Refuses silent fallback to unpinned host binary.
envsubst.rationale: Upstream GNU gettext publishes source code only, zero precompiled Linux release binaries. Go reimplementations lack GNU restricted-variable syntax. Served via signed platform image in bundle/images/.

contractDivergence.source: Decision 10; upstream OpenSSL publishes no Linux binary releases
Decision 10; upstream GNU gettext publishes no Linux binary releases

decisionGuards.decision8: Decision 8: Relationship to ADR-12 — the appliance is a superset, and remote-tenant is one of its modes. Selected at bootstrap by APPLIANCE_MODE=hub|attached.
decisionGuards.decision9: Decision 9: Release trust by digest pin plus bundle-time signing. Third-party platform images are pinned by immutable digest and signed at bundle time with the SLSI release key; no separate release signing pipeline is built. The release private key stays in the build environment; the appliance ships only the public half.
decisionGuards.decision10: Decision 10: Containerise openssl and envsubst, re-scope P1-1 to five Go utilities. bundle/bin/ is scoped to kind, kubectl, flux, cosign, jq. openssl and envsubst are served by a platform image in bundle/images/, digest-pinned and signed at bundle time under Decision 9.
